reviews.text: Great company!!! Robert did a fantastic job on our service. He was very professional and explained everything he was doing. This is definitely a company you can trust. I would give 10 stars if I could. Thank you for your service.

Exceptional experience! I am one of those people who has a guy who can help me with just about anything. It’s just my luck that 2 of my AC peeps were unavailable and the one other person that was, couldn’t be here for about a week. This company moved some things around to make sure we weren’t baking in this Texas summer longer than needed. I loathe big AC companies because they take advantage of anyone they can. All of the reviews that say they make you feel like family are legit. I even had one

10 stars if I could!  My 80yo mom's compressor crashed. Her AC company, who put a whole new system in 4 yrs ago, came out to assess. Compressor was still under warranty and that company (A1) wanted $4000 in LABOR. I stepped in and called Ted at Arlington AC & Heat at 540pm. He listened and sent Bob over that evening to verify it was the compressor and said $4k was way over priced. Long story, AAC/H put in a new compressor for a FAIR price for my mom and she's back to being cool! If it wasn't for

We had an issue with our system not cooling and fan not operating at all. Of course that happen on one of the  hottest and humid days between all the rainy days we’ve had 🤦🏾‍♂️.

After all I could do myself to try to fix the problem I wasn’t able to do, so I called Arlington AC & Heating and spoke with Ted. Firstly, Ted was very easy to talk to and very straightforward and knowledgeable! He quoted me a great price for a service call and diagnostic then he quickly dispatched Robert and he arrived
I highly recommend Arlington Ac and hearing. Ted the owner is amazing and truly wants to help people. He spent so much time explaining things and runs a fabulous company. Thank you so much Ted.

Bryan was polite and professional and was able to get my AC back running smoothly in no time. (Even with the previous home owner's... 'creative' DIY repair to the system which caused the problem.) He explained the issue clearly to me and gave me multiple options for the repair; there is no upsell here and the repair was very affordable. Highly recommended! 😊

I greatly appreciate the service and professionalism of the Arlington AC staff.
Mr. Ted has selected a great group of guys to represent him/company.  Called on Saturday morning and Bob was at my house the same day to diagnose the problem.  When the part arrived, Robert worked all day to replace my compressor and get us cool again.  “Top 5 service” and a customer for life.  Thanks Ted for all you do for your customers!!
Arrived quickly to check my AC issue. Professional, honest, very knowledgeable, kind people, who truly care. 100% recommend. Thank you Ted & Bob!

Exceptional experience with Bob and this company. Bob was punctual, very knowledgeable, efficient and trustworthy. I would give him and this company a 10++ rating and highly recommend Arlington AC & Heating. C Ray, Kennedale
Had to do a system replacement. They were fast, professional, and reasonably priced. If you need a system replacement I confidently recommend them!

I can’t scream this load enough, if you want an honest AC company look no further!!! Not only did they fix our ac but was extremely patient with us during the frustration period of being hot!! Came out immediately and never hesitated or not once tried to up-sale a thing!! I will never use another company! Call them you deserve it!! Thank you Ted and Brian ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Excellent and very professional.  Had Robert work on my mother's AC unit as she had also recently lost her AC contractor.  Robert checked everything out both inside and outside.  And...he replaced her filters!

Fantastic service, owner and technician Bob were very helpful and knew what they were talking about.   Bob really looked at my 16 year old system instead of just trying to sell me a knew one. Bob didn't waste any time and worked quickly,  not typical of someone charging by the hour.   I know who I am calling next time I need AC work.
Great experience every time with Arlington AC. Very reliable & professional makes their company the BEST in the DFW area. Shout out to Robert for diagnosing the problem & getting it fixed so quick!!
Bryan was beyond fantastic.  He fixed my unit and addressed all my concerns.  The price was extremely reasonable.  You've a customer for life and will recommend you to everyone.

I just wanted  to share this with you all that if you ever wanted or are looking for a reliable AC company to work on your units, give Arlington AC  & Heating a call you would not regret it  I have been so pleased with  their services it has been  great and I  will continue to have them as  my AC company. One of the most important thing I found out about this company is that they do really care about their customers. And in my book, that counts. As #1  in Customers Service

My family received amazing care and service from Arlington AC & Heating. I would definitely recommend them!

Our HVAC system went down about a week ago. Spoke with the owner Ted on the phone and he sent Brian out to take a look and give an estimate.
We decided to move forward and had our outside unit and our furnace in the attic replaced.

There has been excellent communication from start to finish for this process. The whole team worked well, were respectful of our home and property, and got us
Robert was great. He was prompt and educated me on all my options

Robert came within an hour if calling and came out and was able to help me find out what I originally was being quoted was not the issue and got me up and going quick! Will never go anywhere else! Thank you!

Ted was amazing. Had a failure with a full unit (due to a lightning strike that grounded the compressor. 22+ years old) that was too old to update, and he and his team worked me into the schedule and had a new complete system installed in two days, at FAR lower pricing than the radio guys. You will be glad you called him!

The Best! I've used more than a dozen AC service providers over the years due to a home warranty and none of them come close. Ted arrived quickly and in about 10 minutes diagnosed our AC problem that 2 other companies had been unable to identify. After 6 days without AC Ted had it working within 24 hrs of getting needed parts.

Ted is awesome! Our AC went out on a Saturday and he came out on Monday and was very professional and honest with us about what needed to be done. He ordered the parts we needed and his crew worked diligently to get the job done as quickly as possible! We will definitely be calling Ted for all of our AC related needs! Alex & Sarah

I called them out for a second opinion after being told the heating unit needed to be replaced. Bob checked and said everything was working and it wasn’t necessary to replace the unit, and didn’t even charge for the call! That’s community service!! I highly recommend this company.
Amazing service. Super quick, knowledgeable, and trustworthy!! These will be my guys forever.

Brian was outstanding! He completely explained everything as he went along in such a way that even I could understand. He explained the issue at hand and then we discussed future maintenance items to consider. I would and will recommend Arlington AC to anyone needing routine maintenance or repairs.

This is a terrific company!  If I could give more than 5 stars I would.  I called a couple of other AC companies and got very poor service.  Ted and Travis took care of business.  They repaired my system.  Communication and customer service were excellent!  Great job!
Arrived on time. Walked me through inspection of unit, and answered all my questions. I would recommend them.

This is the best company I have ever dealt with. Very genuine and they care more about actually catering to each person individual situation instead of just trying to make a buck.

I had an over 20 year old AC system that began to not cool very well at all and needed repairs! A literal block of ice surrounded the system.

Ted came and fixed some minor things completely for free during the initial consultation and diagnosis. He then found the main issue and gave me a very reasonable price!. Howev

Highly recommended from initial phone call to  installation clean up! Owner quickly responded to call, listened to concerns and needs with care and options. Set appointment, was very flexible w/my schedule. Came out on time. Did thorough inspection and explanation of what was needed. Gave two options including pros and cons to both with reasonable pricing. Offered next day installation which started on time, went smoother than expected and left things spotless. Communication was top notch! This

I've been using Absolute Comfort Solutions for years. Ted, the owner is a small business owner that engages with his customers to find the solution that best fits their needs. After Ted had repaired my old AC system for almost a decade, it was time to get a new one. He found the right system for the right price. High quality service and an affordable price. Look no further for your AC and heating problem, call Ted. He's the only one I'll ever use and trust.
Robert was so quick to diagnose the issue, polite and professional. Highly recommend!

Arlington AC & Heating. Ted and his employees are wonderful people. We replaced old Air conditioner and Heating system. We appreciate the quality of work and professionalism and friendliness the installers exhibited. They work very hard and were very polite. We wanted to let Ted and his employees know that they did a wonderful job and we appreciate them.

We had concerns with another company not diagnosing our AC problems. I finally called Arlington AC and heating, And I’m so glad I did. Ted the owner was so nice. He could tell I was upset and frustrated over the other company not correctly fixing our AC.
He came over that day checked our units and correctly diagnosed the problem.
The next day his team was here to do the work. Everyone was so professional,  knowledgeable and clearly explained everything they were doing.

Ted did a great job and explained everything, he checked everything to make sure the system was working well and did multiple tests. Once Ted was done, our system was working great. I would recommend him to family and will be using him again if i ever need his services.

Brian did a great job fixing my AC. He noticed a cable that was wired incorrectly on the compressor and then measured the temperature coming out of the vents to make sure the job was completed.  Great price too.

Thank you Ted! Absolute Comfort Solutions have been taking care of my old air-conditioning units for many years keeping us cool every summer. Ted answers the call and can usually be at the house on the same day. He is courteous and professional and gets the job done right and will work with what you have, not trying to sell you with what you may not need. I would highly recommend his company for any of your air-conditioning and heating needs, I have no complaints. This is a great company!

Professional, quick to respond and fantastic pricing.
Ted is a great guy, very knowledgeable. What I thought would be a nightmare of a repair because a previous repair person was simply just pricing together what he thought was the issue Ted simply just asked a few questions and and a few minutes later we were operational and cant begin to explain how grateful we are to have met him. I will never use another facility Absolute Comfort Solutions is my go to for any future needs.
5 stars do not do

Although AC problems are never pleasant, Arlington AC and Heating made this repair as painless as possible. They came in way under a competitor's quote and actually saved me money on a capacitor that the other company told me was bad when it was fine. This is a great example of their honesty and integrity. Brian was great and had his work cut out for him with my dirty AC coils but he got it done and my house is cold! Couldn't ask for more. Will definitely use in the future.

Ted and his crew were great! They were very thorough in explaining my problem to me. They helped me when another company was trying to deceive me to charge me more money than I need to pay. Ted got me a new unit for the price the other company was going to charge me to repair my current one. These guys do GOOD business. They were a great example of putting people first and serving the community. God bless them. If you have ANY HVAC need call Arlington A/C and Heating!

I told my landlord about the AC not working on a Sunday and, with the temperature still being pretty mild, I wasn’t in a huge rush but mentioned it would be nice if someone could come out the following day. On Monday morning the owner of Arlington AC & Heating, Ted Jessup, called me to check my schedule & try to coordinate a time for him to come out that same day. Ted kept me updated via text messages throughout his morning appointments & was able to fit me in late Monday afternoon. If I had to

I can’t say enough how excellent the service and peace of mind I received from Ted Jessup and his company. My air system was in dire straits when I found and called him. He returned my call within ten minutes and made time to fit me in his already overloaded schedule. He immediately noted the problems, some of which were manufactured by a previous repair from one day before with another company. I have nothing but amazing things to say about BRYAN ! He has come out and helped us get our  AC back up and running ! We used him to replace all of our 4 units and the price was right and the warranty is awesome ! He is extremely knowledgeable and makes sure I understand what’s going on ! Thank you Bryan !

Ted is the most knowledgeable AC repairman with extensive experience!  He came to our rescue when the AC cover on the outside unit was damaged during the winter storm and a replacement was not available from Lennox.  Another company told me they had no idea when a replacement cover would be available.  Ted had the AC running very fast by securing the motor to a brace.  I am very thankful to have found Ted!  He is very professional and courteous!

Ted was a pleasure to deal with prompt and knowledgeable.
I went through three other companies till I found Absolute Comfort Solutions.
Ted makes you feel like your doing business with a friend not a company trying to separate you from your wallet.

Ted And his Team did an amazing job helping me get my Mom a new system installed and started up.  Ted was extremely responsive and helpful.  Pricing was exactly as quoted, fair, and honest.  Thanks againTed for all of your help!!

Justin

I had an excellent experience all around. The issues with my AC unit were resolved at a very reasonable cost. Communication was excellent. Ted was willing to explain everything in great detail. I would highly recommend this service.

Had the pleasure of meeting Mr. Ted today when he came out and fixed my old AC. He he was a very knowledgeable, happy to answer all of my little questions about how things work. He was extremely kind and a pleasure to speak with. It was truly a blessing to have him out and I cant thank him enough for his help.

Just stop and call Ted, he's the one you want.

It was like I had called my own dad to help with my ac issue. He was quick to diagnose and repair our problem while being happy to answer any question and explaining along the way. And to top it all off with a fair price. Ted's just an old school good honest guy.

Bryan did a great job covering the entire AC system to find the best solution for me!   He is very knowledgeable and easy to understand the end result!  Very pleased with the outcome.   Thanks again!!        Carroll Lewis

Bryan was polite,  knowledgeable, and efficient.   He fixed the problem,  offered a number of maintenance tips and a few helpful suggestions regarding our AC system without trying to upsell.  Couldn't  ask for anything more.
